item.title: Whiskers 0.8.54
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.54

### Menu Bar Controls

  • Added quick menu controls for AI Enhancement, Screen Awareness, enhancement prompts, enhancement models, and transcription models so common dictation settings are easier to change

    • ### Recording Reliability

  • Fixed a hands-free recording timing issue so double-tap or toggle recording starts the HUD more consistently

    • ### Audio Cues

  • Improved recording cues so Whiskers lowers system audio relative to your current volume instead of making quiet Macs louder
